Name: Zenith Farm on world map (SVE Only)
Author: Pixew
Description:
[b]This mod can only be used if Stardew Valley Expanded is installed, as it replaces its map files.
[/b]
I made this for personal use, but i decided i'd upload it for other people to enjoy.

It replaces the standard farm spritesheets, don't worry though, there are backups included if you wanna change it later.

If you wanna replace the vanilla world map spritesheets, then you gotta try and do that yourself. I added the "farm only" sprites folder to make it easier to just paste it on top of other spritesheets.

You're allowed to use the sprites i made however you want.

Shortcomings:
When in the farm, the player's head will be placed in the wrong (vanilla) location, don't expect me to fix it though, i have no idea how to.
I didn't want to redraw the whole forest just to add a river there, so the farm's river just ends in... nowhere.
I'm not sure if it blends well with the rest of the map.

Downloads.Description: Changed the color of a single tree on the summer map
